propositions: Jira-specific REST probe logic (URL construction, basic-auth GET, status classification) is currently in backend-neutral core module inbound_probe.py and must be relocated to adapters/jira/probe.py
A new SupportsAbsenceProbe capability protocol must be introduced in _backend.py to abstract vendor-specific probe implementations and allow multiple backends to provide their own absence probes
run_differs.py:369 must route probe dispatch through a capability check (isinstance backend SupportsAbsenceProbe) and pass the backend object, with missing capability degrading to UNREACHABLE result
inbound_probe.py must retain only neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) and lose all adapters.jira imports and vendor REST mechanics
Backend loading order in run_differs.py must be reordered to hoist _load_reconcile_backend() above the probe dispatch call so the backend instance can be passed into the probe routing logic
